description: Count working days between two dates for a UAE emirate/sector (choose which endpoints to include), with the number of Friday half days and the list of non-working days in the range. Use for leave calculations, payroll, project durations and lateness. Example: {start_date:'2026-05-18', end_date:'2026-06-05', emirate:'federal', sector:'public'} → working_days 10, of_which_half_days 2. Response always includes data_confidence ('high' = all dates officially announced/confirmed, 'medium' = something is estimated), estimated_items[], sources[] (official URLs) and data_version.

emirate.description: Calendar profile emirate: federal | abu_dhabi | dubai | sharjah | ajman | umm_al_quwain | ras_al_khaimah | fujairah. Use 'federal' unless the user named an emirate's government. Emirates other than Sharjah currently follow the federal weekend.
emirate.title: Emirate

end_date.description: ISO date. May be before start_date (result is negative).
end_date.title: End Date

inclusive.description: Which endpoints to count: both (default) | start | end | none.
inclusive.title: Inclusive

sector.description: Sector: public (government) | private. Government employees, courts and ministries → 'public'. Companies → 'private' (weekend is employer-set; the common Sat–Sun default is used and flagged).
sector.title: Sector

name: working_days_between
title: Count UAE working days between two dates
